Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 1992
ACT XIV OF 1992
PAKISTAN RANGERS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th July, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 26th
July, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan Rangers
(Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 15, W.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 1959

ACT XIV OF 1992
ACT XIV OF 1992
PAKISTAN RANGERS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th July, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 26th
July, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 15,
W.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 1959.------In the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance,
1959 (W.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 1959), in section 15, in subsection (1) in the
proviso, for the full-stop at the end a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following new proviso shall be added,
"Provided further that. no
disciplinary action against a member of the Force shall be taken without
providing him an opportunity of being heard."
